# X Thread Draft Tool

> Compose and manage X/Twitter thread drafts. Everything the web UI does is available to agents
> through a JSON API, with the same permissions as the signed-in GitHub user.

## Auth

- Connect as an MCP connector: add `/api/mcp` as a remote MCP server; sign in with GitHub once.
- Device flow (no browser needed for the agent): `POST /api/auth/device/start`, show the user
  `user_code` and `verification_uri`, then `POST /api/auth/device/poll` every `interval` seconds
  until it returns 201 with `access_token` (`xta_...`, 1 hour) and `refresh_token` (`xtr_...`).
  Refresh with `POST /api/oauth/token` (`grant_type=refresh_token`, `client_id` from the 201 body).
  The refresh token rotates on every use.
- An access token is bound to one resource: `/api` for the REST API, `/api/mcp` for MCP. Each refuses the other.
- Hand-made token (quick tests): Web UI /settings/tokens, shown once, `Authorization: Bearer xt_...`, 7 days max.
- A token acts as the GitHub user who created it. It can read and change only that user's drafts.
- Revoke a hand-made token with `DELETE /api/tokens/{id}`.
- An invalid, expired or revoked token returns 401. It never falls back to a cookie.

## Quickstart

Set `BASE=https://x-thread-draft-tool-preview.vercel.app` and `TOKEN=xt_...`.

```
# Who am I?
curl -s $BASE/api/auth/me -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# Split long text into thread-sized posts (no auth needed)
curl -s $BASE/api/threads/split -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text":"Long text ...","max_chars":280}'

# Create a draft
curl -s $BASE/api/drafts -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"My thread","posts":[{"id":"p1","text":"First post","images":[],"embeddedTweet":null}]}'

# Update posts (replace the draft id with the one returned above)
curl -s -X PATCH $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"posts":[{"id":"p1","text":"Edited","images":[]}]}'

# Export as text
curl -s "$BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID/export?format=text" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# Create a share link (one-time, expires in 1 hour by default), then read it once (second read returns 410)
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID/share-tokens -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
curl -s $BASE/api/share/SHARE_TOKEN.md

# A reusable link that expires in one day, and how to stop a link
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID/share-tokens -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"expires_in":86400,"one_time":false}'
curl -s -X DELETE $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID/share-tokens/SHARE_TOKEN -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# Publish (deletes the draft's images) and delete
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
curl -s -X DELETE $BASE/api/drafts/DRAFT_ID -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

## Reference

Requests may be in Hebrew; X and Twitter mean the same service.
MCP prompts (slash commands): thread_from_notes, tighten_draft, review_before_publish, rewrite_hook; see the MCP connector guide.
MCP skill (extension io.modelcontextprotocol/skills): skill://x-thread-drafts/SKILL.md, a guide to the draft tools in English and Hebrew; read it with resources/read.

- [MCP connector guide](https://github.com/Shaked/x-thread-draft-tool/blob/main/docs/agents/mcp.md): the tool list, setup for Claude, Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT, troubleshooting.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](/api/openapi.json): every endpoint, schema and error code.
- [Agent guide in the repo](https://github.com/Shaked/x-thread-draft-tool/blob/main/docs/agents/api.md): auth options, limits, how to test.

## Rules

- Draft shape: `{ title, posts: [{ id, text, images: [{ url }], embeddedTweet }] }`.
- Max 280 characters per post (use `/api/threads/split`), max 4 images per post, 4 MB per image.
- Drafts are private. `GET /api/drafts/{id}` and its export return the draft only to its owner (another user gets 404, no token or session 401). Lists, writes and deletes need a token or session too.
- Share links work once by default and expire 1 hour after creation (`expires_in` sets 60 seconds to 7 days; `one_time` false makes a reusable link). Owners can stop a link with DELETE. Image URLs from `/api/images` or `/api/images/from-url` are Vercel Blob URLs.
- Errors are JSON: `{ "error": "message" }` with an HTTP status.
